title: Pathway to Glory
notes: Start game > Solo player > New creates a campaign; the first mission is Pantelleria, summer 1943.

The game is turn-based: move the cursor over the map and press OK to send the selected soldier there (the green line shows the path and what it costs). Key 7 opens the mission menu with End turn, Mission data, Use (weapons and gear), Commands and End mission.

A Bluetooth battle works between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer): Start game > Local battleground, then one chooses Host a game and Create, the other Join a game and the host's name. The host chooses Start game once the other is listed under Accept players, then Start the battle; both go through the briefing, the team and the gear. Cooperative only showed a page about the full game's features. Global battleground is N-Gage Arena, which is no longer online.

multiplayer.menu: Start game > Local battleground > Host a game / Join a game
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chooses Host a game and Create, the other Join a game and the host in the list; the host then chooses Start game and Start the battle, and each player passes the briefing and picks a team and gear. A battle (Chef-Du-Pont 1944, Allies against Axis) ran on both screens and the turn passed back and forth. When one chose End mission, the other read "Campaign won".

controls.source: The shortcuts shown in the game's own Commands menu (stance up 8, stance down 0, look at 9, previous 1, next 3) and the soft key labels in its menus; the cursor, OK, key 5 (the soldier moved and his action points dropped) and key 7 were observed in the first mission. Publisher and year are from the game's logo screens and general knowledge.

actions.up: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.down: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.left: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.right: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.ok: Select (menus); send the selected soldier to the cursor
actions.5: Battlefield action key: confirm the move to the cursor
actions.7: Mission menu (end turn, use gear, commands)

notes: The standard layout suits this game: arrows move the cursor, Enter is OK, Q and W are the soft keys, and the digit row gives 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9 and 0.
On a gamepad A is OK, Y opens the mission menu (its Commands list has every action, so the number shortcuts are not needed), LB selects and RB goes back.

statusNote: Title, menus, campaign creation, briefing, team and gear selection work, and the first mission (Pantelleria) plays on the battle map: moving a soldier, switching soldiers and the mission menu were tried. The dump came without the GameComms library (the app then exits at launch with "Can't find GAMECOMMS.DLL"), so the pack tool takes it from the Ikusa Islands card.
